intents.intent: Architecture reasoning engine detecting smells and producing actionable improvement advice. Integrates with architecture_memory to contextualize suggestions with past decisions.

Run full architecture analysis aggregating risk metrics, cycle detection, subsystem analysis, god module detection, and dependency depth into structured advice. Optionally loads past decisions from architecture_memory to enrich suggestions.

CLI entry point with commands for build, analyze, tasks, apply, query, explain, suggest (with support for all rule types: required_call, forbidden_call, forbidden_path, layer_boundary, dependency_limit), delta, diff, validate, status, cas, semantic, plan, architecture, viewer, architect, enrich, compile, code-plan, lock, drift, copilot-context, arch-simulate, arch-diff, arch-memory, archi-test, context, evolve, health, intent-apply, intent-missing, memory, metrics, multilevel, path, refactor, repair, simulate, subsystems, test-impact, version, and visualize
Run architecture advisor detecting smells and suggesting improvements, with optional JSON output and save. Passes project_root for architecture_memory integration.
Run full architecture evolution loop: advisor, target delta, task generation. Uses project_root-aware advisor for memory-enriched suggestions.

AST extraction engine (Graph_0). Parses Python source files to extract nodes (functions, classes, modules), call sites, imports, and resolve call targets. Includes ambiguous method name filtering to prevent false positive fan-in from common builtins (get, append, add, etc.).

Suggested workflow and architecture policy manager. Manages rules (required_call, forbidden_call, forbidden_path, layer_boundary, dependency_limit), detects violations, and provides CLI-backed add/remove/list/validate/diff/stats/import operations.
